scholarships.name: DOST-SEI RA 7687 Science and Technology Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school graduates belonging to economically disadvantaged families; top performers in STEM subjects
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, book allowance, transportation allowance, thesis allowance, MS/PE uniform allowance
scholarships.requirements: Grade 12 graduate, STEM strand preferred, belonging to Top 5% of graduating class or with high aptitude in STEM, Filipino citizen, no pending DOST scholarship, physically and mentally fit
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually opens August–September, closes October–November annually
scholarships.applicantNotes: Separate from the general DOST-SEI S&T Undergraduate Scholarship; RA 7687 specifically targets disadvantaged families. Must pass the DOST-SEI Undergraduate Scholarship Examination.

scholarships.name: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarship (JLSS)
scholarships.eligibility: Regular 3rd year college students enrolled in priority S&T fields at identified DOST-SEI institutions
scholarships.benefits: Tuition subsidy, book allowance, MS/PE allowance, thesis/dissertation allowance, transportation allowance for those outside home province
scholarships.coverage: Partial to full tuition and allowances
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, 3rd year standing, GWA of at least 2.75 (or equivalent), no failing grade, no pending DOST scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually opens 2nd quarter, check DOST-SEI announcements
scholarships.applicantNotes: For students already in college who were not DOST scholars in 1st year. Covers 3rd year until graduation.

scholarships.name: CHED Tertiary Education Subsidy for LSIs (Persons Deprived of Liberty)
scholarships.eligibility: Persons Deprived of Liberty enrolled in higher education programs
scholarships.benefits: Tuition and other school fees subsidy, allowance
scholarships.requirements: Must be enrolled in CHED-recognized program, certified LSI status
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Varies by academic year; coordinate with UniFAST regional offices
scholarships.applicantNotes: Special category under TES. Coordinate with BJMP or BuCor for certification.

scholarships.name: DAR Agrarian Reform Community Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Children of agrarian reform beneficiaries
scholarships.requirements: Child of ARB, enrolled or enrolling in agriculture-related or any CHED-recognized program, good moral character
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Varies; check with local DAR office
scholarships.applicantNotes: Priority given to agriculture and related fields but may accept other programs.

scholarships.name: NCCA Scholarship for the Arts
scholarships.eligibility: Young Filipino artists in various arts disciplines
scholarships.benefits: Training and development grant, mentorship, allowance
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, 18-35 years old, demonstrated artistic talent, not a previous NCCA scholar in same category
scholarships.applicantNotes: Covers various arts categories: music, dance, theater, visual arts, literary arts, film, etc.

scholarships.name: DSWD Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) — Educational Assistance
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino families in crisis situations with school-age children
scholarships.benefits: One-time educational cash assistance per student
scholarships.coverage: Cash grant (amounts vary by level: elementary, junior HS, senior HS, college)
scholarships.requirements: Valid ID, enrollment proof, certificate of indigency or crisis documentation
scholarships.location: National (through DSWD Field Offices and LGUs)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling basis; usually distributed before school opening
scholarships.verificationSource: DSWD official website and news reports
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not a full scholarship — one-time cash assistance. Long lines typical during distribution periods. Coordinate with local DSWD office.

scholarships.name: PVAO Educational Benefit for Veterans' Dependents
scholarships.eligibility: Dependents of Filipino military veterans
scholarships.requirements: Child or dependent of certified veteran, proof of enrollment, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply through PVAO regional offices. Benefit amount depends on veteran status and number of dependents.

scholarships.name: Philippine Navy Scholarship Program (PNSP)
scholarships.eligibility: Qualified Filipino citizens entering BS Naval Architecture, BS Marine Engineering, and related fields
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, uniform allowance, guaranteed commission upon graduation
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, allowances, active duty pay during training
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, 17-22 years old, single, physically fit, meets PN height/weight standards, qualifying exam passer
scholarships.verificationSource: Philippine Navy official website and recruitment materials
scholarships.applicantNotes: Requires commitment to serve in the Philippine Navy after graduation. Designated schools include MEP-designated institutions.

scholarships.name: Philippine Air Force Flying Scholarship / AFROTC Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Qualified college students in AFROTC or aspiring PAF officers
scholarships.benefits: Tuition assistance, monthly allowance, flight training subsidy for selected cadets
scholarships.coverage: Partial to full tuition, allowances, flight training costs
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, physically fit (Class 1 flight physical for flying), meets PAF age and height requirements, enrolled in AFROTC
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Coordinate with PAF Recruitment Center and university ROTC units
scholarships.applicantNotes: Flying scholarship is highly competitive. AFROTC scholarship available at universities with active PAF-detached AFROTC units.

scholarships.name: Philippine Army Officer Candidate Course (OCC) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: College graduates or graduating students who want to become Philippine Army officers

scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, baccalaureate degree holder, 21-29 years old, physically and mentally fit, no pending cases

scholarships.applicantNotes: Not a traditional scholarship but a commissioning program with full financial support during training.

scholarships.name: BJMP Scholarship Program for Dependents of Jail Officers

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Philippines)
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens with at least 2 years work experience (for postgraduate); some undergraduate options
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, establishment allowance, Overseas Student Health Cover
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, meets academic and work experience requirements, not a dual citizen of Australia
scholarships.applicantNotes: Primarily for postgraduate study. Strong preference for applicants from development-related fields who will return to PH.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship (Philippines)
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens with at least 2 years work experience, leadership potential
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel costs, visa fees
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, 2+ years work experience, not a dual citizen of UK, meet Chevening eligibility criteria
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually opens August, closes November annually
scholarships.applicantNotes: For master's degree only. Requires returning to the Philippines for at least 2 years after study.

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarship for Filipino Students
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens with bachelor's degree (for postgraduate) or completing bachelor's (for some programs)
scholarships.benefits: Full or partial tuition, monthly stipend, travel allowance, health insurance
scholarships.coverage: Tuition and living expenses (varies by program)
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, bachelor's degree (for most), language requirements (English or German depending on program)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Varies by program; typically 4-6 months before start date
scholarships.applicantNotes: Germany offers many English-taught master's programs, especially in engineering and sciences. Tuition at public universities is often very low or free.

scholarships.name: Korean Government Scholarship Program (KGSP) for Filipinos
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens under 25 (undergraduate) or under 40 (graduate)
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, Korean language training, settlement allowance
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, meets age and academic requirements, no Korean citizenship
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually opens February–March (embassy track) or September–October (university track)
scholarships.verificationSource: Korean Government Scholarship Program official website and Embassy of Korea in PH
scholarships.applicantNotes: Includes 1-year Korean language training before degree program. Both embassy and university tracks available.

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) for Filipinos
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens in good health, under 25 (undergraduate) or varying limits for other levels
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, stipend, accommodation, medical insurance
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, meets academic and age requirements, HSK Chinese proficiency may be required for some programs
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually January–April; check Embassy of China in PH
scholarships.verificationSource: CSC official website and Embassy of China in the Philippines
scholarships.applicantNotes: Many English-taught programs available. Apply through the Embassy of China in Manila or directly to Chinese universities.

scholarships.name: Taiwan Scholarship for Filipino Students
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens under 30 (undergraduate) or under 35 (graduate)
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, meets academic requirements, not a dual citizen of Taiwan
scholarships.verificationSource: Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in the Philippines
scholarships.applicantNotes: Many English-taught programs in Taiwan. Strong in engineering, IT, and business.

scholarships.name: ASEAN Scholarship for Filipinos (Singapore)
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens who are outstanding students
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, annual allowance, accommodation, settling-in allowance, return airfare
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, strong academic record, excellent co-curricular record, pass selection tests and interview
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually 1st-2nd quarter; check MOE Singapore website
scholarships.verificationSource: Singapore Ministry of Education official website
scholarships.applicantNotes: Highly competitive. Also available for secondary and pre-university levels. Bond requirement to work in Singapore for 3 years after graduation.

scholarships.name: Erasmus+ Mundus Joint Master Degree Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens with bachelor's degree; cannot have previously resided in EU for more than 12 months
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel allowance, installation allowance, insurance
scholarships.requirements: Bachelor's degree, meet specific program requirements, English language proficiency
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Varies by program; typically October–January for next academic year
scholarships.applicantNotes: For joint master's degrees offered by consortia of European universities. Study in 2+ countries. Highly prestigious.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Philippines Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens with strong academic and professional credentials
scholarships.benefits: Tuition, monthly stipend, book and travel allowance, health insurance
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, bachelor's degree with high GPA, at least 2 years professional experience (for some categories)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually October–November for the following academic year
scholarships.applicantNotes: Multiple categories: student, scholar, specialist, etc. Administered by PAEF in Manila.

scholarships.name: New Zealand Scholarships for Philippines
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens from eligible target sectors
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, establishment allowance, insurance
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, at least 2 years work experience (postgraduate), meet academic requirements
scholarships.applicantNotes: Priority sectors include agriculture, renewable energy, disaster management. Postgraduate only.

scholarships.name: French Government Scholarship through Campus France Philippines
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens pursuing studies in France
scholarships.benefits: Monthly stipend, social security coverage, exemption from university tuition fees (at public institutions)
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, admission to French institution, meet program-specific requirements
scholarships.applicantNotes: France offers very low tuition at public universities. France is particularly strong in arts, culinary, engineering, and business.

scholarships.name: Don Bosco Technical Institute Scholarship (Makati/Manila)
scholarships.eligibility: Deserving male students from low-income families
scholarships.benefits: Tuition discount to full scholarship, tools, uniform
scholarships.coverage: Partial to full tuition and training costs
scholarships.requirements: Male, financially needy, good moral character, at least high school graduate
scholarships.verificationSource: Don Bosco Technical Institute Makati official website
scholarships.applicantNotes: Don Bosco schools are known for quality technical-vocational education. Male-only institution.

scholarships.name: Dualtech Training Center Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Male high school graduates or college level
scholarships.benefits: Free training, allowance during in-plant training, employment pathway
scholarships.coverage: Full training costs and allowance during industry training
scholarships.requirements: Male, 17-25 years old, at least high school graduate, physically fit, mechanically inclined
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling admissions; multiple batches per year
scholarships.applicantNotes: Dual training system: classroom + industry partnership. High employment rate after graduation. Male-only.

scholarships.name: MFI Technological Institute Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school graduates interested in industrial technology
scholarships.benefits: Tuition discount to full scholarship depending on financial assessment
scholarships.requirements: High school graduate, pass MFI entrance exam, financially needy
scholarships.applicantNotes: MFI (formerly Meralco Foundation Institute) is one of the premier industrial technical training institutions in the Philippines.

scholarships.name: TESDA Barangay Kasanayan sa Kabuhayan (BKK)
scholarships.eligibility: Out-of-school youth and unemployed adults in partner barangays
scholarships.benefits: Free skills training, tool kit, training allowance
scholarships.coverage: Full training costs and starter tools
scholarships.requirements: At least high school level, at least 18 years old, barangay resident endorsement
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling basis; coordinate with barangay and TESDA
scholarships.applicantNotes: Community-based training program. Short courses (days to weeks). Coordinate with your barangay for scheduling.

scholarships.name: TESDA Training for Industry (TRAIN) Program
scholarships.eligibility: Workers and would-be workers for specific industry demands
scholarships.benefits: Free training aligned with industry needs, possible employment after
scholarships.requirements: Meets specific industry training requirements (varies by program)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling basis; driven by industry demand
scholarships.applicantNotes: Industry-driven training. Often leads to direct employment with partner companies.

scholarships.name: TESDA Specialista Technopreneurship Program
scholarships.eligibility: TVET graduates who want to start their own businesses
scholarships.benefits: Entrepreneurship training, starter tool kit, business mentoring, linkages to financing
scholarships.requirements: TESDA-certified graduate, at least 18 years old, business idea aligned with training
scholarships.applicantNotes: For those who already have TESDA certification and want to become entrepreneurs rather than employees.

scholarships.name: TESDA Skills for Employment Scholarship Program (SESP)
scholarships.eligibility: Unemployed and underemployed individuals
scholarships.requirements: At least high school graduate, 18+ years old, unemployed or underemployed
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Verify if this is distinct from TWSP/STEP
scholarships.verificationSource: TESDA website (program may have been consolidated)
scholarships.applicantNotes: May have been consolidated into TWSP or other TESDA programs. Verify current status.

scholarships.provider: Philippine Australia Technical Training and Vocational Education and Training (PATTVET)
scholarships.name: TESDA-Australia TVET Partnership Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: TVET scholars in specific Australian-standard programs
scholarships.requirements: Meets specific program requirements
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Verify if still active — may have transitioned
scholarships.applicantNotes: This partnership program may have been completed or transitioned. Verify current status with TESDA.

scholarships.name: Rotary Club Scholarship (Various Philippine Rotary Clubs)
scholarships.eligibility: Deserving students sponsored by local Rotary Clubs
scholarships.coverage: Partial to full tuition (varies by club)
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, financial need, endorsed by a Rotary Club
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Varies by club; typically before school year
scholarships.verificationSource: Rotary International and Rotary District 3810/3790/3780/3820/3830 Philippines pages
scholarships.applicantNotes: Each Rotary Club has its own scholarship program and criteria. Contact your local Rotary Club directly.

scholarships.name: JGF Accredited Schools Scholarship (SHS and College)
scholarships.eligibility: Students enrolled at JGF partner schools in hospitality and culinary programs
scholarships.benefits: Tuition assistance, industry immersion at Jollibee Group brands
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled at JGF partner school, in hospitality/culinary program
scholarships.applicantNotes: Distinct from the general JGF scholarship already listed — this is specifically for accredited partner schools with industry immersion component.

scholarships.name: Cebu Pacific Cadet Pilot Program (with scholarship component)
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino citizens who meet CAAP and Cebu Pacific cadet pilot requirements
scholarships.benefits: Flight training subsidy, pathway to Cebu Pacific First Officer position
scholarships.coverage: Training costs (with study-now-pay-later or scholarship for top candidates)
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, 18-28 years old, college graduate (any course), meet height and medical requirements, pass aptitude tests
scholarships.location: Philippines (training at Cebu Pacific partner academies)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not a traditional scholarship but has scholarship components for top cadets. Primarily a study-now-pay-later model with guaranteed employment.

scholarships.name: CHED Expanded Student Grants-in-Aid Program for Poverty Alleviation (ESGP-PA)
scholarships.eligibility: Students from Listahanan-identified poor households
scholarships.requirements: Listahanan-identified poor household member, enrolled in CHED-recognized program, not a recipient of other CHED scholarships
scholarships.applicantNotes: May have been transitioned into the UniFAST TES system. Verify current application process with CHED/UniFAST.

scholarships.name: DA-BAR Scholarship for Agriculture and Fisheries
scholarships.eligibility: Students from farming and fishing communities
scholarships.requirements: From farming/fishing household, enrolled in agriculture/fisheries program
scholarships.verificationSource: DA-Bureau of Agricultural Research official website
scholarships.applicantNotes: Specific to agriculture and fisheries-related programs only.

scholarships.name: DOH Special Training for Health Professionals (various specialty scholarships)
scholarships.eligibility: Health professionals seeking specialization
scholarships.requirements: Licensed health professional, admitted to DOH-recognized training program
scholarships.applicantNotes: Separate from the DOH Health Scholarship Program already listed (which is for undergraduate). This is for residency and specialty training.

scholarships.name: DILG Seal of Good Local Governance — Education Incentive (indirect scholarship support)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of LGUs that pass the SGLG assessment (which includes education indicators)
scholarships.benefits: LGUs with SGLG seal may receive additional education fund allocation
scholarships.coverage: Indirect — enables LGU to fund more scholarships
scholarships.requirements: Resident of SGLG-passing LGU
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Not a direct scholarship — informs which LGUs may have better education funding
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not a direct scholarship but useful context — SGLG-passing LGUs tend to have stronger education programs and scholarship budgets.

scholarships.name: ABS-CBN Lingkod Kapamilya Educational Assistance
scholarships.eligibility: Students affected by calamities and crises
scholarships.requirements: Affected by crisis/calamity, documented need
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Crisis-driven; not a regular scholarship cycle
scholarships.applicantNotes: ABS-CBN's franchise was not renewed in 2020; their foundation operations have been significantly reduced. Program may be limited or inactive. Verify before recommending.

scholarships.name: GMA Network Scholarship Program (Kapuso Foundation)
scholarships.eligibility: Deserving college students, priority to media/communication-related fields
scholarships.benefits: Tuition assistance, allowance, possible internship at GMA
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, financial need
scholarships.verificationSource: GMA Network and GMA Kapuso Foundation pages
scholarships.applicantNotes: May prioritize communication, broadcast, and media arts programs.

scholarships.name: Villar Foundation Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Deserving students from Las Piñas and nearby areas
scholarships.requirements: Resident of covered area, good academic standing, financial need
scholarships.location: Las Piñas and nearby areas, NCR
scholarships.applicantNotes: Associated with the Villar family. May have geographic focus on Las Piñas and Cavite.

scholarships.name: DITO Telecommunity Scholarship / Telecom Training Program
scholarships.eligibility: Students in telecommunications, IT, and engineering
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled in relevant program, good academic standing
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Verify if a formal scholarship program exists
scholarships.verificationSource: DITO Telecommunity website (no clear scholarship page found)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Status unknown — DITO is a new telco. They may have CSR education programs but a formal scholarship has not been clearly verified.

scholarships.name: Maynilad Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Dependents of Maynilad employees and students in engineering/environmental programs
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, in relevant program (engineering, environmental science)
scholarships.location: Metro Manila and Cavite (Maynilad service areas)
scholarships.applicantNotes: May be primarily for employee dependents. Verify external applicant availability.

scholarships.name: Manila Water Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students in water-related, engineering, and environmental programs
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, in relevant program
scholarships.location: Metro Manila and Rizal (Manila Water service areas)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Manila Water Foundation also runs WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) programs in schools.

scholarships.provider: University of the Philippines Los Baños
scholarships.name: UPLB Academic Scholarship (UP Oblation and UPLB-specific)
scholarships.eligibility: Top UPCAT passers choosing UPLB
scholarships.requirements: Top UPCAT passer for UPLB quota
scholarships.applicantNotes: UPLB is the premier agricultural and environmental science university in the Philippines.

scholarships.name: EAC Academic Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Top EAC entrance exam passers and continuing students with high GPA
scholarships.requirements: High academic standing at EAC
scholarships.applicantNotes: EAC has campuses in Manila and Dasmariñas, Cavite.

scholarships.name: OLFU Academic Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Top OLFU entrance exam passers and continuing students with high GPA
scholarships.requirements: High academic standing at OLFU
scholarships.verificationSource: Our Lady of Fatima University official website
scholarships.applicantNotes: OLFU has multiple campuses including in-scope regions. Strong in health sciences and criminology.

scholarships.name: PWU Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Top PWU entrants and continuing students with high GPA
scholarships.requirements: High academic standing at PWU
scholarships.applicantNotes: PWU accepts both male and female students despite the name. Known for nutrition, music, and education.

scholarships.name: PCU Scholarship and Financial Aid
scholarships.eligibility: Qualified PCU students based on merit and/or financial need
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing and/or financial need documentation
scholarships.applicantNotes: PCU has campuses in Manila and Dasmariñas, Cavite.

scholarships.name: NU College of Engineering and Architecture Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Top NU entrants in engineering and architecture programs
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled in NU engineering/architecture program, high academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: NU has been investing heavily in engineering and architecture programs under the SM Group ownership.

scholarships.name: LPU Academic Scholarship (All Campuses)
scholarships.eligibility: Top LPU entrance exam passers and continuing students with high GPA
scholarships.requirements: High academic standing at any LPU campus
scholarships.applicantNotes: LPU has multiple campuses. Each campus may have specific scholarship variants.

scholarships.name: MCL Academic Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Top MCL entrants and continuing students with high GPA
scholarships.requirements: High academic standing at MCL
scholarships.applicantNotes: MCL is a Mapua-owned school in Laguna. Strong engineering and IT programs.

scholarships.name: DLSU-D Scholarship and Financial Assistance Program
scholarships.eligibility: Qualified DLSU-D students based on merit and/or financial need
scholarships.benefits: Tuition discount, stipend for qualified scholars
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing and/or financial need
scholarships.applicantNotes: DLSU-D is one of the largest Lasallian institutions. Separate scholarship system from DLSU Manila.

scholarships.name: NFA Scholarship for Children of NFA Employees
scholarships.eligibility: Dependents of National Food Authority employees
scholarships.requirements: Child of active NFA employee, good academic standing
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Verify if this program still exists
scholarships.verificationSource: NFA website (no clear scholarship page found)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Status unknown — many government agency employee benefit programs have been reduced. Verify with NFA HR.

scholarships.name: PAG-IBIG Fund Education Program (if available)
scholarships.eligibility: PAG-IBIG members
scholarships.requirements: Active PAG-IBIG member with sufficient contributions
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Discontinued — PAG-IBIG now focuses on housing and calamity loans
scholarships.verificationSource: PAG-IBIG Fund official website (no education loan listed in current products)
scholarships.applicantNotes: PAG-IBIG does not currently offer an education loan. Listed here to prevent confusion. The SSS Educational Assistance Loan Program (already listed) is a separate program.

scholarships.name: PhilHealth — No Direct Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: N/A
scholarships.requirements: N/A
scholarships.deadlineNotes: PhilHealth does not offer scholarships — listed to prevent false assumptions
scholarships.verificationSource: PhilHealth official website — no scholarship program exists
scholarships.applicantNotes: PhilHealth provides health insurance coverage, not education subsidies. Listed explicitly to prevent misinformation.
